ns2:course.label: Global Youth and Citizenship
ns2:course.description: Discusses youth and citizenship in a global context. Covers the social construction of children and youth, the sociology of global generations, education and social media, and new youth movements in the digital age. Draws on a diversity of case studies from North America, the Middle East and North Africa, sub-Saharan Africa, Europe and Latin America. Same as EPOL 525. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
